jobPostingInfo.title: Claims Development Program Internship
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor H-1B petitions or STEM OPT for this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Learn strategies for investigating and resolving claims.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Candidates graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 are preferred.
  • Suggested college majors include Business Administration, Risk Management, Insurance, or a business-related discipline.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor’s degree.
